_doc: Example plausibility limits for typical environment and motion sensors, board lying still on a desk at room temperature. Field names = TAG.key as the firmware prints them; make one file per board/app and tune it with evidence (date and board in 'why'). Physics only - no board facts here.

ENV.t.why: air temperature sensor; a running board warms it by several C

ENV.p.why: pressure in Pa (sea level ~101325, about -12 Pa per m altitude)

IMU.amag.why: |acceleration| at rest = 1 g in mg; outside = moving or wrong range scaling

MAG.bmag.why: |B| of the Earth's field in nT (25-65 uT); far above = a board-fixed offset (hard-iron) to calibrate
